name_input: MOUNT ROOFING AND STRUCTURES PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/mount-roofing-and-structures-private-limited) shows 561 records, all in the IMPORT direction; every visible row has India as DESTINATION, e.g. "2026-02-24 | HEBEI NALI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD | MOUNT ROOFING AND STRUCTURES PRIVATE LIMITED | DIAGIONAL RIDGE OR/WH GR/WH - 1050MM | Xiamen, CHINA -> CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India | HS 39259090 | BOL 7710954". No export row, no outbound destination, no export B/L number was seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher, and the search backend (searx) was unreachable ("Connection refused") for every query, so no domestic-supply record was observed.
note: Import-side activity is real and dated (latest cargo 2026-02-24, 6 trading partners, 9 port lanes; top lanes CHENNAI SEA 189, Xiamen 162, CHINA PEO REP OF 48, CHENNAI SEA INMAA1 41, BusanKorea 18). Counter check: page header claims "Total Shipments 561", but only 5 individual rows were rendered in the free view — the 561 figure is a platform aggregate and was NOT verified row-by-row. Imported goods (PC resin HS 39074000 from Lotte Chemical, roofing ridge profiles HS 39259090 from Hebei Nali, Guangdong Gongli building materials) are consistent with a roofing/structures fabricator buying raw material and fittings, i.e. an importer-processor, not an exporter. Declared HS 680911 (boards/panels of plaster or gypsum) does not match any observed customs line — actual observed codes are 39259090 and 39074000; per project rule this is not a rejection ground, HS should be corrected to the factual codes. No export shipments found; no domestic supply evidence found either — следов поставок на экспорт не найдено, по внутреннему рынку данных нет. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). Registry/catalogue data deliberately not used as evidence.
